features.name: Suspension in ordinary call operands
features.scope: Source, compiled static/member and function-value invocation operands evaluate once in source order, including the receiver and callback value. Temporaries are saved across coroutine resumption before invoking the enclosing call. Fixed Java callers compiled against official output verify member receiver/argument traces, two sequential suspensions in nested call arguments, function-value/source calls, and exceptions both before and after a resumed argument.
restrictions: Constructor operands remain explicitly unsupported to preserve allocation and initialization timing. Existing JVM local limits and unsupported state-machine/declaration shapes remain explicit.
